import json
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_list.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":120,"var":"Data","code":"write (fd, Data, Size)","note":"The fuzzer harness stores attacker bytes in the file that the GnuPG parser will later read."},
 {"step":2,"file":"g10/decrypt.c","function":"decrypt_message","line":27,"var":"fp","code":"fp = iobuf_open (filename)","note":"The crafted file is reopened as a message stream for packet parsing."},
 {"step":3,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"do_proc_packets","line":1575,"var":"pkt","code":"case PKT_PLAINTEXT: proc_plaintext (c, pkt); break;","note":"The parser decodes a literal-data packet and hands it to the plaintext-processing path."},
 {"step":4,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_plaintext","line":827,"var":"pt","code":"PKT_plaintext *pt = pkt->pkt.plaintext;","note":"The plaintext object is taken from the packet and kept as the basis for later processing."},
 {"step":5,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_plaintext","line":833,"var":"pt->namelen","code":"if (pt->namelen == 8 && !memcmp( pt->name, \"_CONSOLE\", 8))","note":"This path shows that proc_plaintext relies on the parsed plaintext structure contents before freeing the packet list later in the function."},
 {"step":6,"file":"g10/parse-packet.c","function":"parse_comment","line":3020,"var":"packet->pkt.comment","code":"packet->pkt.comment = xmalloc (sizeof *packet->pkt.comment + pktlen - 1)","note":"For a comment packet with zero payload bytes, the unsigned subtraction underflows and turns the allocation size into a huge value, creating the memory-safety failure."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
